resources.string: Starts the game from its title screen. Your saves are on the memory card.
Disc 2 isn\'t added yet. The game asks for it at the end of disc 1.
Disc 1 isn\'t added yet. A new game starts on disc 1.
No BIOS yet. The game\'s own saves need one: add a BIOS dumped from your PlayStation. Save states work either way.
Pick your Parasite Eve discs: the .cue and .bin files of both discs together, or a .chd, .pbp or .iso file for each. Disc 2 can wait until the game asks for it. The app keeps its own copy.
Add a PlayStation BIOS under BIOS for the game\'s own saves. Without one the emulator runs on OpenBIOS, a free stand-in, which may not save Parasite Eve. Save states work either way.
None of those files is a disc image. Pick the .cue with its .bin files, or a .chd, .pbp or .iso file.
The .cue file needs these files too: %1$s. Pick them all together.
That\'s more discs than fit there. Pick Parasite Eve\'s two discs, or just one when adding or replacing a single disc.
Your .pbp already holds both discs. To use separate discs instead, replace disc 1 first.
Import or back up your saves
A short buzz when a hold, L1, R1, Select or the menu gesture registers
Hold, then drag (or hold and swipe with another finger)
Hold, and tap with another finger
Two-finger tap, then two-finger tap and hold
D-pad, any of 8 directions, held while your finger stays down: walk, pick in menus
Cross: examine, talk, OK; in battle, carry out the command
Triangle, with Circle still held. Tap again for another, for as long as you hold
R1 on the right half of the screen, L1 on the left, held: scroll menus
L1 / R1: scroll menus up / down
This app\'s menu: save states, discs, speed, picture (pauses the game)

Swipes press the D-pad as soon as they start, and follow your finger: the D-pad points where it last moved, so turning around is instant. Moving back to where the swipe started lets go. While one finger walks, a second can tap for Cross or hold for Circle. While a finger holds Circle, taps with another finger are Triangle.
Scanlines, like the TVs of the day (best at 1× resolution)
How many times the PlayStation\'s resolution the 3D is drawn at: %1$d× is %2$d × %3$d. Aya and the creatures get sharper; the backgrounds are pictures and keep their own. Higher uses more battery.
Stops the PlayStation\'s wobbling polygons and warping textures.
No saves yet. The game creates the card the first time you save.

The game saves to memory card 1 like on a PlayStation, and both discs use it. It\'s written to the phone as soon as the game saves. Import a card from another emulator or a PlayStation (.mcd, .mcr, .srm, .gme, .vmp) to carry on from it; the card it replaces is kept as a backup. Export makes a copy (.mcd) that other emulators read.
That file isn\'t a PlayStation memory card.
No BIOS yet: the emulator runs on OpenBIOS, a free stand-in, which may not save Parasite Eve to the memory card.

Add a BIOS dumped from your own PlayStation (any region, 512 KB, like scph1001.bin or scph5501.bin) so the game\'s own saves work. It\'s used from the next time the game starts. A save state made before still runs on the old BIOS.
That file isn\'t a PlayStation BIOS (they\'re 512 KB, from Sony).
When the game asks for disc 2, open this app\'s menu and pick disc 2. Delete frees the space; your memory card and save states stay.
A save state keeps the exact moment, anywhere in the game, even mid-battle. The game\'s own saves go on the memory card.
Loading goes back to that moment, with the disc that was in. The memory card isn\'t changed.
Loaded slot %1$d. It\'s from before your BIOS: to save in the game, start from the title screen.
The emulator is missing from this build of the app.
The emulator couldn\'t open the discs. Try adding them again under Discs.
This phone\'s graphics don\'t support what the emulator needs (OpenGL ES 3).
Something went wrong in the emulator.
%1$s is available. You have %2$s.\n\nDownload it (%3$s) and install it now? Installing closes the app: save first, the game starts again from its title screen.
